environment.name: JIRA_SERVER
environment.description: Jira instance base URL, e.g. https://jira.example.com

environment.name: JIRA_USERNAME
environment.description: Jira account email or username for the runtime account

environment.name: JIRA_PASSWORD
environment.description: Jira API token or password for the runtime account

environment.name: JIRA_PROJECT
environment.description: Default project key used by jira init (e.g. BUG)
